newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wheelock offers extra 50 Parc Royals flat.
newsitem.headline: Wheelock offers extra 50 Parc Royals flat.

text.p: Wheelock Properties Ltd, unit of Wheelock and Co Ltd, said on Tuesday it was offering an additional 50 luxury flats at its Parc Royale Development in Shatin on top of the 30 units it offered on January 20.
The company said in a statement the 50 units ranging from 975 to 1,603 square feet would be priced four percent higher than the first additional batch, at about HK$6,150 per square foot.
Wheelock said sale registration for the 80 flats would end on Wednesady and the units would be on sale this Saturday.
It said it would limit the ratio of corporate purchasers to 15 percent and 85 percent of the units would be sold to individual purchasers, a move to curb speculation on property market.
Priority of selecting units will be decided through computer balloting, it said.
Parc Royale is a luxury residential development in Shatin in New Territories comprising a total 640 units of which 80 percent of the flats had been sold.

The territory's luxury property market has surged in recent months which led mainly by growing speculative activities. Many property developers had voluntarily introduced measures to tackle the speculation.
